topic: Current antweight hardware and running gear

entities.name: Repeat Rubber Flex Wheel 1.75in (2 pack)
entities.summary: Combat-robot wheel with an injection-molded ABS core and TPE tread, sold in 30A and 45A durometers.
entities.notes: Designed to mate with Repeat Gold Screw or Gold Clamp hubs. Weight is for a pair, not per wheel.

entities.name: Repeat Gold Clamp Hub
entities.summary: 7075-T6 aluminum wheel hub that clamps around the shaft instead of relying on radial set screws.
entities.notes: The current product page lists two M3 wheel-mount holes on a 1/2-inch (12.7 mm) circle and a clamp-screw/slot shaft retention design.

entities.name: Repeat Gold Screw Hub
entities.summary: 7075-T6 aluminum wheel hub retained by two oversized M4 set screws and carrying a four-hole M3 wheel pattern.
entities.notes: Two M4 x 4 mm set screws are arranged 90 degrees apart. Four M3 tapped holes sit on a 12.7 mm hole circle.

entities.name: Repeat AR600 2.75in Blade for 2207 Hubmotor
entities.summary: Pre-cut AR600 weapon blade sized for Repeat's 2207 antweight hubmotor.
entities.notes: This record is specifically the 2.75-inch / 6 mm / approximately 58 g 2207-hubmotor option. The same product page also lists larger antweight and beetleweight blade variants with different thicknesses and masses.

entities.name: Repeat 267-3M-05 Scalar Spinner Belt
entities.summary: Thicker-than-standard 267-3M-05 timing belt used by Repeat's 1 lb Scalar horizontal-spinner kit.
entities.notes: Repeat states that this belt works with its 18T ant weapon pulley and is thicker than standard FingerTech belts for improved durability.

entities.name: Repeat Plastic Antweight Hardware Kit
entities.summary: Plastic-antweight hardware assortment with motor screws, armor hardware, shaft/standoff parts, two weapon bearings, O-rings, and tools.
entities.notes: Vendor contents also list M3 nuts, armor-mounting screws, two M5x25 drum-support screws, two M5 locknuts, and three assorted Allen keys. Verify the current contents before treating the assortment as a complete BOM.

chunks.title: Current antweight wheels, hubs, and weapon-drive hardware
chunks.body_md:
Running gear is easy to under-spec because wheel diameter alone does not tell you how the wheel attaches or how much rotating/unsprung mass it adds. For current Repeat hardware, the 1.75-inch Flex wheel is a separate molded wheel that expects a compatible hub; the Gold Clamp and Gold Screw hubs use different shaft-retention strategies but share a 12.7 mm wheel-mount circle. Store wheel and hub weights separately when building a weight budget.

Weapon transmission parts need the same specificity. A belt code or blade diameter is not enough by itself: record the exact product or profile, width/thickness, compatible hub/pulley interface, and mass when the vendor publishes it. The AR600 2.75-inch blade record here is specifically the 6 mm, approximately 58 g variant for the 2207 antweight hubmotor; it should not be treated as representative of every blade on the product page.
